data.name: Barthol
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Aramaic name Bar-Talmai, which translates to 'son of Talmai'. In the New Testament, Bartholomew is identified as one of the twelve apostles. He is also known as Nathanael.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith and devotion to spiritual teachings.

biblical_reference.note: One of the twelve apostles. He is also known as Nathanael or Bartholomew the Apostle.

saint_reference.note: Apostle and evangelist. Tradition holds that he was martyred in India.

data.cultural_impact: Bartholomew is considered a patron saint in various regions and countries, including Portugal, where he is referred to as "infante do paraíso" ("infant of paradise"); Canada, where he is the patron saint of fur traders; and Taiwan, where he is believed to protect farmers. In popular culture, Bartholomew is often depicted as a strong and fearless figure.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bartholomew is significant as a reminder of the apostle's dedication to spreading the Gospel message. It reflects his willingness to leave his previous life behind and follow Jesus, as evidenced by the name's derivation from 'son of Talmai'. The name also reminds us of the importance of faith, as Bartholomew's identification as one of the twelve apostles signifies his place among the inner circle of Jesus' disciples. Ultimately, the name Bartholomew serves as a reminder of the transformative power of faith and the importance of remains steadfast in one's beliefs.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bartholomew was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus. The name Barthol carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Barthol remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Barthol from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Barthol - "Son of Talmai". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Barthol carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Biblical tradition. As a name associated with Saint Bartholomew the Apostle, it represents holiness, devotion, and Christian virtue.
